lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule across Ethiopia. Geographic polygons represent areas classified into IPC phases (1-5) indicating acute food insecurity severity. Data includes multiple scenarios and is aggregated into near-term projections for policy and humanitarian response planning.
